title: DCG-GAN: Design Concept Generation with Generative Adversarial Networks
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This paper introduces DCG-GAN, a generative adversarial network framework for design concept generation. It addresses the limitations of traditional GANs in generating creative and diverse design concepts by incorporating criteria such as novelty, diversity, and desirability. The study validates the model through quantitative and qualitative assessments involving 89 participants.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not include human evaluations through subjective ratings or genealogical tree approaches. The study focuses on quantitative metrics and does not involve direct collection of human subjective perceptions.
